message.content:
The Continental Congress formally adopted the text of the Declaration of Independence on **July 4, 1776**.  
However, the official signing ceremony—when the delegates affixed their signatures to the parchment—took place a few weeks later, on **August 2, 1776**, at the Pennsylvania State House (now known as Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
